paragraphs.text: Wenceslao Zamudio Lozano was arrested in Arrest MTY-10-01 on 2010-09-06. Círculo del Valle Quieto was linked to Arrest MTY-10-01 on 2010-09-06. Arrest MTY-10-01 occurred at Monterrey on 2010-09-06. A detained courier in contact with the reporting office stated that federal forces arrested Zamudio, a sicario chief for the newly formed Círculo del Valle Quieto known to his crew as El Mapache, at a house in a Monterrey suburb within a week of the network's founding. The courier described the arrest as the result of a tip from a rival crew that had been pushed out of the freight lots.

Wenceslao Zamudio Lozano used DEMO-ACCT-00088 on 2010-09-06. Aurelio Castañón Vidaurri led Círculo del Valle Quieto from 2010-09-01 until 2019-05-23. The courier stated that the account identifier above was found among Zamudio's effects and that it had been used to pay his crew. The courier characterized Castañón as the network's head and stated that the arrest did not affect the network's operations because Zamudio's crew was absorbed by another enforcer. The courier added that Zamudio had been warned about the house by his own crew and had refused to move, which the courier attributed to a dispute with Castañón over money rather than to carelessness.

The reporting office assesses the courier as having direct knowledge of the crew structure but secondhand knowledge of the arrest itself. The source has provided reporting of comparable quality over the preceding reporting cycle. The reporting office notes that the arrest of a sicario chief so soon after the founding may indicate that the network's early security was weak. Further reporting is expected as the source maintains contact with the individuals named.
